page.title: PyTorch Ambassador Activities
page.subtitle: Completed, scheduled, proposed, and ongoing community activities

events.title: Start Your AI Career with PyTorch
events.impact_summary: An introductory workshop designed to help beginners start their machine-learning journey with PyTorch and understand practical AI career pathways.

events.title: Build a Naija RAG for Local Context with PyTorch
events.impact_summary: Participants build a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system using Nigerian local knowledge while learning practical PyTorch workflows.

events.title: Solving Local Challenges with PyTorch
events.impact_summary: Demonstrating how PyTorch can be applied to real-world Nigerian challenges across education, healthcare, agriculture, finance, and other sectors.

events.title: Start Your AI Career with PyTorch
events.impact_summary: An introductory PyTorch workshop focused on helping students begin building and training neural networks using open-source tools.
